items.title: Add proof surface inventory docs and machine-readable surface map
items.context: Covers plan M0. Inventory current proof-looking surfaces, producer boundaries, binding fields, artifact consumers, and evidence scope. Must include candidate-only Repro artifacts from B-0aa1 and non-authority/local diagnostic surfaces.
items.userSees: User sees docs/evidence/proof-surface-inventory.md and .json listing each proof-looking surface with scope, producer boundary, consumers, and whether productionDone is allowed.

happy.desc: Inventory includes every M0 surface named in the plan, including done-required evidence, delivery/review artifacts, Authority receipt refs, local diagnostics, handoff, local quorum, and B-0aa1 Repro candidate artifacts.

edge.desc: Inventory explicitly marks non-production scopes such as evidence-candidate, local-diagnostic, local-key-single-host, authority-receipt, and legacy-observed as unable to set productionDone.

adversarial.desc: A reader cannot confuse raw Repro candidate, local diagnostic Authority status, or authority-receipt-only evidence with production-gate-decision proof.

items.title: Implement shared proof admissibility domain and registry
items.context: Covers plan M1. Add core module/types for EvidenceScope, TemporalRole, ArtifactRole, ClaimKind, ArtifactConsumerKind, ProofProducerBoundary, reason codes, artifact definitions, and classification result. Must be reusable by future gates and must not create a separate storage root.

items.title: Add classification/evaluation helper for proof-looking artifacts
items.context: Provide a caller-facing API that answers what a surface may prove, whether it is admissible for a consumer/claim, and why not. Include productionDone=false behavior for local diagnostic, candidate, local-key, authority-receipt without matching production gate decision, and legacy scopes.

items.title: Add smoke tests and process fact registration for admissibility classification
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage for accepted/denied scopes, stale/material binding cases where applicable, local diagnostic overread prevention, candidate-only Repro surfaces, and registry completeness. Register any new command/task/runtime fact needed by the process fact contract.
